transkript.t: You can now copy any animation from any website, video or give, with one command.
It's called Reanimate, a free skill for clod code built by developer Niyaz Morshid.
Here's the problem. Ask an AI to rebuild an animation from a link or a screenshot,
and it makes one attempt, calls it done and misses.
It can't actually see the motion. Reanimate fixes that.
It films the original in a real browser, writes down every moving part,
rebuilds it in your code, then films the copy and compares the two, frame by frame.
It keeps fixing the biggest difference until the numbers match.
On Versailles toolbar, it matched 417 out of 417 frames.
It even works on WebGL and 3.js effects.
It's open source and already has over 800 stars on GitHub.
Honestly, this is how you learn great motion designs.
Take it apart, then make it your own.
